ruleDefinitions.name: Visual Studio Code Tunnel Shell Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a shell (powershell, bash, wsl...) via Visual Studio Code tunnel. Attackers can abuse this functionality to establish a C2 channel and execute arbitrary commands on the system.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\servers\\\\Stable\\-.*") AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\server\\\\node\\\.exe$") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.vscode\\-server.*")) AND (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\terminal\\\\browser\\\\media\\\\shellIntegration\\\.ps1.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\wsl\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bash\\\.exe$")))
